data: Cinci oameni simpli trecuți de prima tinerețe au trupa “Dio Family”. Doi taximetrişti, un zugrav, un brutar și un asistent medical încearcă să iasă din monotonia de zi cu zi, prin pasiunea pentru muzică. Lipsa banilor, a timpului liber, oboseala, eșecurile sunt la tot pasul, dar nimic nu îi opreşte, pentru că simt că dacă se dau bătuți vor pierde și acest ultim pariu de a-şi găsi fericirea. (Five working-class people form the band "Dio Family". Two taxi drivers, a house painter, a baker and a nurse are trying to break out from day-to-day monotony through their passion for music. Their lives are governed by financial issues, exhaustion and failures, but nothing stops them, because they feel that if they give up, they will lose this last opportunity to find happiness.)

Five working-class people form the band "Dio Family". Two taxi drivers, a house painter, a baker and a nurse are trying to break out from day-to-day monotony through their passion for music.
